### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **42** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**31** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 80a9f99222a62c336659bef6e8dcabd7ffb7b1b3`.

⛔ **12** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (symbol, 48 pages)`
- **8** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **212** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **180** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 80a9f99222a62c336659bef6e8dcabd7ffb7b1b3` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `fc83a0a8bfe0601d11df5e7b501c809d2ca6298d` — the merge of head `e68dae860ca61761f550856546d6af37ddd3ccd4` into base `80a9f99222a62c336659bef6e8dcabd7ffb7b1b3`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin fc83a0a8bfe0601d11df5e7b501c809d2ca6298d && git checkout fc83a0a8bfe0601d11df5e7b501c809d2ca6298d
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 80a9f99222a62c336659bef6e8dcabd7ffb7b1b3 e68dae860ca61761f550856546d6af37ddd3ccd4 && git checkout -B drift-repro 80a9f99222a62c336659bef6e8dcabd7ffb7b1b3 && git merge --no-ff e68dae860ca61761f550856546d6af37ddd3ccd4

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 80a9f99222a62c336659bef6e8dcabd7ffb7b1b3
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 80a9f99222a62c336659bef6e8dcabd7ffb7b1b3` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

triage#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw58ehQ2gRHP2h2Puz

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e68dae860ca61761f550856546d6af37ddd3ccd4`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec: `ui/action.zod.ts` (`description` and each `outcomeMessages` value through `actionCopy(...)` with the locale map; `ActionParamSchema.helpText` through `actionParamHelpText()` without one; describes), `ui/action-copy-template.ts` (`ActionCopyKey` widened to six, `ActionRowCopyKey` keeps the page rows at three, per-key `SLOT_NAME` / `EXAMPLE`, three describe constants), `system/i18n-resolver.ts` (`ActionLike` / `ActionParamLike` type the envelope), `ui/component.zod.ts` (row keys typed `ActionRowCopyKey`), `ui/action.form.ts` help, semantic migration entry `action-dialog-outcome-copy-template-holes` (no conversion), liveness `outcomeMessages` evidence; packages/lint `validate-action-copy-templates.ts` (`REGISTERED_KEYS` / `INLINE_KEYS`, `valuesOf` paths `outcomeMessages.OUTCOME` and `params[N].helpText`, roots per key); readers: `@object-ui/core` `ActionRunner` (`dialogCopyOf`, `composeSuccessMessage` via `actionCopySource`) + `actionCopyText`, `@object-ui/react` `useActionTextLocalizer`, `@object-ui/fields` `resolveActionParams`, app-shell `ActionPreview.tsx`, runtime `summarizeActionParams`, cli `i18n-extract`; platform producers (`invite-outcome-messages.ts`, `sys-invitation` / `sys-member` descriptions and `permission_set_granted` outcomes, four `objects.generated` + four `metadata-forms.generated` bundles); dogfood ledger rows `template-action-dialog-copy` / `template-action-outcome-message`; docs; two changesets (`@objectstack/spec` + `@objectstack/lint` minor, platform-objects / runtime / cli patch, ADR-0087 `registered`; `@object-ui/core` / `react` / `fields` patch). 57 files, +1360/−211 against merge-base 776c1d87, merge-tree clean. Fixes #27948 step 2 (ruling A 6545229148; claim 6546254270 + amendments 6546313079 / 6546830184 / 6547728288; step 1 = #28436, lane PASS 6546030702). Not governed (no `skills/**`, no `docs/adr/**`; skills follow-up #28464).
Inputs: card #27948 thread (ruling, both claims and the three amendments, the step-1 report with its two step-2 findings), the PR body, the PR diff at this head (every non-test, non-generated hunk read in full; tests by case; translation bundles by count), `git grep` on `origin/main` (`actionCopySource` / `fillTransitionalCopy` in `actionCopyTemplate.ts` and `templateSlotSource` in `flow-text-slot-template.ts` exist from step 1), the hold note 6548021215 on the red head `408466db` and the delta to this head (one commit `e68dae86`, 5 files, +26/−10: the three stale string pins read the parsed `description` as the template envelope — cli `i18n-extract-action-description.test.ts` L173 `toEqual({ dialect: 'template', source })`, plugin-approvals `sys-approval-request.object.test.ts` and `translations/approve-decision-question.test.ts` through `templateSlotSource` — and the two TSDoc sentences in `action.zod.ts` / `action-copy-template.ts` now say the `${…}` → `{{ }}` rewrite is by hand and the semantic entry registers no conversion; no producer or reader moved), check-runs (read 2026-10-31T20:27Z: all 65 latest-per-name check-runs completed, 58 success + 7 skipped, none failed, none running) — 65 checks. Nothing built or run here; the seat's numbers (spec 773 files / 22871, lint 183 / 7699, platform-objects 104 / 1474, 116 derived gates, the reverse checks per pin) are the PR body's.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Ruling A's step 2, as ordered.** Step 1 (#28436) taught the console `{{ }}` on the three keys while `${…}` kept reading; this step closes the spec (the three keys typed as `template` slots with the describes teaching `{{ }}`), adds the publish refusal (the lint pass judges `description`, each `outcomeMessages.OUTCOME` and each `params[N].helpText` through the same judge as `confirmText`, every finding an error so the gate answers 422) and registers the migration. All five keys now speak one hole syntax, which is what A decided; B (lint only) is not what shipped.
- **Roots follow the key each slot stands beside.** `description` / `helpText` take `actionConfirmTemplateRoots(action)` (the dialog opens before the run, over `record`; a registered action's `params` binds nothing), an `outcomeMessages` entry takes `ACTION_SUCCESS_TEMPLATE_ROOTS` (`result`, `record`). That matches what step 1's runner fills (`dialogCopyFiller` over record + static params; `composeSuccessMessage` over result + record), so lint and renderer agree on the closed scope. Step 1's second finding (the `${…}` path read the whole runner context, e.g. `user`) is answered: a hole over any other root is refused by name, and the migration entry says such logic moves into the handler's answer.
- **The parse keeps loading stored rows.** Each slot keeps the blank-string arm and a `${…}` sentence still parses; refusal is at the doors only, and the console keeps the transitional `${…}` reading for a sentence with no `{{ }}` hole. So a stored action loads and reads as before until its next save, which is judged. `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` + `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` + the `!` title + ADR-0087 `registered` (semantic entry, no conversion because a `${…}` token held an expression) are the right declarations; the FROM → TO list in the changeset is the migration prose.
- **Every reader the typing breaks is in the first commit** (step 1's first finding, objectui#13367's trap): core `dialogCopyOf` hands the dialog text not envelopes; `composeSuccessMessage` reads an outcome envelope's `source`; react keeps an outcome envelope's shape for the bundle; fields `resolveActionParams` reads `helpText` through `actionCopySource` (the fifth reader, forced by Type Check UI, amendment 6547728288); app-shell `ActionPreview` localizes the envelope; runtime `summarizeActionParams` reads `helpText`'s text; cli `i18n-extract` seeds the envelope as the string. `action-icon.tsx`'s tooltip is left with the stated reason (an envelope reaches it only with an empty label, which `useActionTextLocalizer` never leaves empty).
- **Platform copy converted** on the right roots (`result.email`, `result.grantedPermissionSet.label`, `record.email`, `record.user_id.name | default:'this member'`), with the `default`-vs-`??` difference named; the four bundles regenerate identically (`check-i18n-bundles` in sync). HotCRM's six `${result.*}` outcomes are carried by hotcrm#2384; `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`'s hole list by #28464 — both open.
- **Should-fix, recorded:** fixed on this head. The step-1 `action.zod.ts` `outcomeMessages` TSDoc claimed `os migrate meta` rewrites stored copy while the semantic entry `18.action-dialog-outcome-copy-template-holes.ts` registers no conversion; the docblocks now state the entry names a hand edit and registers none, which matches the entry.
- Tier S by path; `check-governed-merges` not governed; seat lands after this record and green CI.

### ② Rulings cited

- 6545229148 (spec seat 2 recording the maintainer's 「同意」 on the 2026-10-31 list item 4, 2026-10-31T15:13Z): letter **A**, two steps, renderer first. Step 2 implemented as ruled; no open ruling.

### ③ Narrowing / widening

- Narrowing at the doors: a `${…}` token, a single-brace `{x}` token, a hole over an unbound root, logic or an unknown formatter in a hole, or a blank sentence on `description`, `params[N].helpText` or an `outcomeMessages` entry is refused at `objectstack validate` / `compile` and at the publish gate (422). Stored rows still parse; the console's transitional read keeps them working.

### ④ Behaviour / flags

- `os migrate meta` lists `action-dialog-outcome-copy-template-holes` with no conversion: authors rewrite `${…}` copy by hand per the FROM → TO list.
- Follow-ups open: hotcrm#2384 (knowledge-article outcomes), #28464 (skills hole list).

Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibw58ehQ2gRHP2h2Puz`

domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 动作的 `description`（参数对话框说明）、每个参数的 `helpText`、每条 `outcomeMessages` 现在和 `confirmText`、`successMessage` 一样是 `{{ }}` 模板槽。`os validate`、编译和发布闸（422）会拒绝其中的 `${…}`，并给出 `{{ }}` 的写法。平台自带文案和四种语言的翻译已经改好。
- **为什么改：** 你裁定 #27948 选 A。这是第二步：第一步 #28436 已让控制台认 `{{ }}`，这一步把契约收口，以后动作文案只有一种插值写法。
- **风险与回滚：** 这是收窄（标题带 `!`）。已存的 `${…}` 文案仍能解析，控制台过渡期照常填充；作者新写或再发布时才会被拒，按升级指南里的条目手工改写。读这三个键的五处代码已同步改为读新结构，并都有测试。回滚即 revert。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`（三个键的类型和说明）。
- **两分钟验证：** 跑 PR 正文“验证”一节列的 spec 动作测试，预期全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无。不属于受管面，契约复审已 PASS，由席位落地。技能文档 #28464 和 HotCRM 的同类文案 hotcrm#2384 另开卡跟进。
- **席位意见：** ACCEPT，可落地。

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · 2026-10-31T20:30Z

Head `e68dae860ca61761f550856546d6af37ddd3ccd4`. Card #27948 step 2 of 2, claim 6546254270 + amendments 6546313079, 6546830184, 6547728288 (five envelope readers: `@object-ui/react` text localizer, runtime `summarizeActionParams`, cli `i18n-extract`, Studio `ActionPreview`, `@object-ui/fields` `resolveActionParams`); ruling 6545229148, letter A (maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-31T15:10Z). Step 1 was #28436.

- **Shape:** draft to `main`, made by the relay; `Fixes #27948`; `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` at line start; `Skills-docs: follow-up #28464`. Title carries `!`; changeset minor with the ADR-0087 marker; semantic migration entry `action-dialog-outcome-copy-template-holes` (no conversion; the TSDoc says so).
- **Contract review:** PASS by the lane review thread, record 6548733114 on this head (delta after 408466db: three re-pinned tests and two TSDoc sentences; the should-fix is recorded fixed), reviewer not the drafter. No must-fix.
- **Diff read by the seat:** 57 files, +1360/−211. Readers first (commit 1, plus the forced `fields` commit), then the spec typing and the door refusal, then the producers and bundles. Every in-repo hole has a `record` or `result` root (census in the body). The console keeps step 1's `${…}` read for stored rows. `action-icon.tsx`'s `label || description` tooltip is left (not reachable from a parsed slot), noted in Acceptance notes.
- **Follow-ups filed:** #28464 (skills hole list, Tier H), objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2384 (knowledge article vote outcomes; converts in the pin bump that carries this PR; `Blocked-by: #27948`).
- **Gates:** check-runs on this head 58 success, 9 skipped, 0 red, 1 in progress (started by the label edit); auto-merge waits for it. Full dogfood exit 0 locally. `check-governed-merges --branch`: NOT governed, 57 paths, +1360/−211.
- **Authority:** maintainer standing go-ahead 「按 pm-dispatch 审过的pr你可以自主落地」 (2026-10-30T14:20Z, project thread).
